cohort: 30 HIV-positive pregnant women receiving ART at Nalanda Medical College & Hospital, Patna, India
finding: ART drugs and appropriate care during the antenatal, intrapartum, and postpartum periods improved maternal and perinatal outcomes in HIV-positive pregnant women.
mod_finding: 57.14% of HIV-positive women had a vaginal delivery and 42.85% delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 22% of newborns
